Classification per wolf-learning-cycle: one-off noise / working note — no repetition observed, 'helped this one time only'. Bounds: do NOT promote to a rule or lesson; do not add cache-cleaning to any procedure. A successful one-time command is not a global rule. If the stale-cache failure repeats (>=2 independent occurrences), treat it as a NEW signal: diagnose root cause first (wolf-debug), then classify."
